title: Equivalence of assigned-label fibers
statement: Let $q$ finite sets, each of size $k$, have empty symmetric difference, and choose a permutation of the $k$ indices for each part. For any element $x$ of the ambient $n$-element set, the labels assigned to $x$ form a set in bijection with the parts whose component contains $x$.
